title: NOAA: ice-core CO2 stayed at or below 300 ppm for the last 800,000 years
summary: The same NOAA article says CO2 did not get above 300 ppm in the ice-age cycles of the past million years or so, and that an 800,000-year ice-core series never shows it higher than 300 ppm.
body: NOAA Climate.gov says that during the ice-age cycles of the past million years or so, atmospheric carbon dioxide did not get any higher than 300 parts per million. The same article's caption for an 800,000-year ice-core series says that throughout that time CO2 was never higher than 300 ppm. The article states both the "million years or so" sentence and the 800,000-year series. This card does not choose a different ceiling.
